function.name: Media_3_FindMovies
function.description: Explore movies online based on your preferences including genre and starring actors. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: The genre of the movies to explore.

starring.description: The actors or actresses starring in the movie. Use 'any' to indicate no preference.

function.name: Media_3_PlayMovie
function.description: Stream the selected movie online with the option to choose from a variety of subtitle languages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

title.description: The name of the movie to be streamed.

subtitle_language.description: The preferred language for the movie subtitles.

function.name: Weather_1_GetWeather
function.description: Retrieve the weather forecast for a specified city on a given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The name of the city for which the weather forecast is required, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country'; e.g., 'New York, NY' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'. The default value represents the current date.
